name: Esports
author: contra
description: Spoiler-free match schedule for the Omarchy bar. The next match for a team you follow sits on the chip with a countdown; click for what is live, coming, and still to watch. Scores are withheld by a daemon rather than merely undrawn. Dota 2, Counter-Strike and StarCraft II out of the box; 37 games one toggle away. Requires the omarchy-esports daemon.

barWidget.description: Upcoming matches for the teams you follow, with stream links and spoiler-free VODs. Requires the omarchy-esports daemon.

schema.label: Show match label
schema.description: Show the next match beside the icon rather than the icon alone

schema.label: Show finished matches
schema.description: List recently finished matches so their VODs are reachable

schema.label: Followed teams only
schema.description: List only matches involving a team you follow; toggled from the panel header
